review_method: Previously inspected images transferred through strict full-native shape/frame checks.
observations: Eight same-sided rocking arms share the transverse shaft, including distinct reverse and clutch receivers. This corrects the withheld doubled reverse/missing clutch arrangement.
Three pedestals and two end keepers engage actual shaft stock. Open rod eyes remain explicit until the next route stage.

Section shows each complete 50.8 mm screw starting below floor, crossing floor/strip and terminating inside a real blind casting receiver. This is a selected support interpretation, not demonstrated historical mounting.
M638 station solves the 1257.3 mm rod-core length against a provisional driver datum. The driver parts do not yet establish that datum.
limitations: M3019 arrangement/orientation, M639 cast dimensions, shaft size/height, neutral clocking and transverse lanes are approximate.
Axial rocker locations are intended to be maintained by subsequent rod connections; no unsupported extra collars were invented.
Source drawings have longitudinal breaks, so there is no whole-vehicle dimensional camera fit.
Standard floor piece mark remains unresolved; native metadata identifies development context without an unsupported M1936 assignment.
